D: Carter and Lee chase a counterfeiting ring from Hong Kong to Las Vegas.
P: Serve the mains when they hit the Red Dragon casino.
S: Hong Kong pork and prawn siu mai

Open-topped dumplings of pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake and ginger, steamed until juicy, topped with a dot of carrot and served with chilli soy. Soak 4 dried shiitake in hot water for 20 minutes, then chop finely. Mix with 300g pork mince, 150g chopped green prawns, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp cornflour. Cup 20 round wonton wrappers in your hand, fill and squeeze into open baskets. Top with finely diced carrot. Steam 8 minutes over boiling water. Serve with soy and chilli oil.
Crisp fried prawns tossed in a wok with garlic, red chilli and spring onion
Salt and pepper prawns: shell-on prawns dusted in potato starch, fried at 190C, tossed with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion.
M: Ricky Tan's Hong Kong roast goose
Duck for goose: five spice, dried overnight and roasted, plum sauce and jasmine rice

Roast duck (goose is hard to find): five spice and salt inside, skin dried overnight, glazed with maltose or honey, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes. Rub the cavity of a 2kg whole duck with 2 tsp five spice and 1 tsp salt, and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry the skin. Brush with 2 tbsp honey loosened with hot water and roast at 180C for 90 minutes, brushing again twice. Rest 15 minutes and chop through the bone. Serve with 150ml plum sauce and 2 cups jasmine rice.
Red Dragon casino prime rib plate
Carter's big night in Las Vegas

Garlic and herb-crusted beef rib roasted pink and carved thick, with red wine gravy, creamy horseradish, crispy roast potatoes and buttery corn. Rub a 1.5kg boneless beef rib roast with 3 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C for about 50 minutes until 54C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock. Boil 4 corn cobs 6 minutes and butter. Serve with horseradish cream.
W: Chilled mango, coconut milk and sago pearls
Cook sago pearls until clear, rinse, chill. Blend mango with coconut milk and evaporated milk, fold in sago, top with diced mango and pomelo.
Silky egg and evaporated milk custard tarts in pastry

Shortcrust or puff pastry cases filled with egg custard (eggs, milk, sugar syrup, evaporated milk), baked at 200C for 15 minutes until just set. Dissolve 70g caster sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Whisk in 3 eggs, 80ml evaporated milk and 40ml full cream milk, then strain. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry and press into a greased patty tin. Fill three quarters full and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble.
K: Strong black tea strained smooth and sweetened with evaporated milk
Brew strong black tea for 5 minutes, strain through a fine cloth twice, add evaporated milk and sugar. Hot or over ice.

steps.text: Press the tofu between clean tea towels under a weight for 30 minutes, then cut into thick slabs.
Rub with the five spice and salt and toss in the oil.
Roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Brush with the honey loosened with the hot water and roast for 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice and serve with the tofu and plum sauce.

s.note: Crisp fried prawns tossed in a wok with garlic, red chilli and spring onion
s.how: Dry 500g shell-on green prawns well, season with salt and white pepper and toss in 60g potato starch. Fry in batches at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp. In a wok, fry 4 sliced garlic cloves, 1 sliced red chilli and 2 sliced spring onions in a little oil for 30 seconds, add the prawns and toss well.

m.n: Ricky Tan's Hong Kong roast goose
m.note: Duck for goose: five spice, dried overnight and roasted, plum sauce and jasmine rice
m.how: Rub the cavity of a 2kg whole duck with 2 tsp five spice and 1 tsp salt, and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry the skin. Brush with 2 tbsp honey loosened with hot water and roast at 180C for 90 minutes, brushing again twice. Rest 15 minutes and chop through the bone. Serve with 150ml plum sauce and 2 cups jasmine rice.

w.note: Chilled mango, coconut milk and sago pearls
w.how: Boil 80g sago pearls in plenty of water for 15 minutes until clear, then rinse under cold water and chill. Blend the flesh of 2 mangoes with 200ml coconut milk and 100ml evaporated milk. Fold in the sago, divide into bowls and top with diced mango from a third mango and segments of half a pomelo.

w.note: Silky egg and evaporated milk custard tarts in pastry
w.how: Dissolve 70g caster sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Whisk in 3 eggs, 80ml evaporated milk and 40ml full cream milk, then strain. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry and press into a greased patty tin. Fill three quarters full and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble.

d.note: Strong black tea strained smooth and sweetened with evaporated milk
d.how: Simmer 4 tbsp loose black tea in 800ml water for 5 minutes. Strain twice through a fine cloth or sieve for a smooth tea. Add 200ml evaporated milk and 4 tsp caster sugar, stir, and serve hot or poured over ice.
